hermes.goal: Beat buy-and-hold (positive alpha vs BTC) while keeping max drawdown under 15% and never risking the mandate on a single trade — capital preservation first. Near-term: prove a sustained, fee-aware, positive out-of-sample edge on the paper trainer over ~90 days before scaling any live capital; grow the live account only on demonstrated alpha.

brain.commentary: The crypto universe shows modest conviction overall, with BTC the only clear long bias and a tiny positive composite. ETH, SOL and LTC are flat to negative on composite, have negative alpha, elevated volatility and poor liquidity, making their signals fragile. The majority of altcoins are flagged long but have zero volatility and risk metrics, indicating insufficient data rather than strong conviction. Given the mixed signals and a cross‑asset risk‑on backdrop, we stay neutral and modestly scale down exposure (0.85×). Small conviction tweaks reflect the relative confidence and fragility of eac
